name: Pallet Town
description: A quiet town of new beginnings. The gate north leads to Route 1. Tile layout and map connections are built in src/map.py; this file carries NPCs and encounter data only.

npcs.name: Professor Oak
dialogue: Hello there! Welcome to the world of Pokemon!
My name is Oak. People call me the Pokemon Professor!
This world is inhabited by creatures called Pokemon!
My lab is right behind me -- come in whenever you like.
Route 1 lies through the gate to the north. Mind the tall grass!

npcs.name: Gary
dialogue: Hey! I'm Gary, Professor Oak's grandson!
I'm going to be the world's greatest Pokemon trainer!
That's my house behind me. Not that you're invited.

npcs.name: Young Boy
dialogue: The Pokemon Center heals your whole team for free!
Just walk in through the door up there.

npcs.name: Townswoman
dialogue: The pond here is my favourite spot in town.
It's so peaceful... nothing ever happens in Pallet Town.

npcs.name: Gate Keeper
dialogue: Heading north? That road runs straight through to Viridian City.
Stick to the path and the wild Pokemon will leave you be.
